==Absence of Blue searcher==

I just removed text claiming that the reason Siuan and Moiraine don't deliver messages to a Blue is that one could have been summoned innocuously, and that it was therefore the Blue who likely betrayed Tamra to the Black. Nonsense. First, it would be no easier to summon a Blue than any other sister. The fact that she was raised from the Blue, if anything, would make summoning Blues more noticeable because sisters are always looking for signs of favouritism. Also, sending an Accepted to summon a sister is already innocuous, so the suggestion really makes no sense. It was the summoning of five of the most powerful AS in the Tower in such a short period (with a rumour about Gitara having a Foretelling) that was suspicious, as well as the women's reactions to the cryptic summonses. In any event, the suggestion (again, calling itself the "most likely" reason for no Blue) is made entirely without any fact backing it up, so it doesn't belong. -[[User:Rrius|Rrius]] 19:28, January 15, 2012 (UTC)
